activity.notes: Jogaila recovered the Lithuanian grand-ducal position in 1382 and held it until the 1392 settlement that established Vytautas as Grand Duke. This is a second, separate Lithuanian reign, overlapping from 1386 with Jogaila's Polish kingship.

sources.title: Jogaila — Visuotinė lietuvių enciklopedija
sources.citation_text: The Lithuanian Universal Encyclopedia identifies Jogaila as Grand Duke of Lithuania in 1377-1381 and again in 1382-1392, and as King of Poland from 1386 to 1434.
